# Al-Ulama Easy Editor

> AI-powered Islamic research, transcription, OCR, and text-to-speech suite with full Urdu, Arabic, and English support — built for scholars and students.

Al-Ulama Easy Editor (EasyEditor) provides a grounded Islamic GPT research assistant (Quran & Hadith citations), long-form audio transcription, image-to-text OCR for Arabic/Urdu/English, and natural text-to-speech voices.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Basic, Pro, and Ultra plans (PKR).
- [Sign up](/signup): Create an account (manual admin approval).
- [Log in](/login): Sign in with email or Google.

## Features

- [Islamic Research](/research): Citation-grounded answers from Quran and Hadith.
- [Transcribe](/transcribe): Urdu, Arabic, and English audio transcription.
- [OCR](/ocr): Extract Urdu, Arabic, and English text from images.
- [Speak](/speak): Multilingual text-to-speech with multiple voices.
